technique_name: Describe a single day at the beach.
description: The day at the beach started off with a beautiful sunrise that painted the sky with pastel oranges and pinks. I grabbed my towel and beach bag, and headed to the beach. I stopped to get a cup of coffee and some breakfast along the way. Once I arrived at the beach, I set up my spot and soaked in the sun.
